description: PyPI virtual repositories isolate locally-owned project names from the same name upstream by default (PEP 708, dependency-confusion mitigation). Declare a <track>tracks</track> relationship to re-union a local project's versions with a named upstream Simple index.
emptyDetail: Locally-owned project names are fully isolated from upstream.
confirmDescription: "{name}" will be isolated from upstream again. Unpinned installs will resolve only the local project's versions.
